pattern: join on id, compute per-row delta, average by group
question: for each centre how much did the shuttle sprint time change on average between the two tests
gold_sql: SELECT b."Location", AVG(e."Shuttle Run sec" - b."Shuttle Run sec") AS avg_shuttle_change FROM sportathon_baseline AS b JOIN sportathon_endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY b."Location" ORDER BY b."Location"
sql_duckdb: WITH baseline AS (SELECT "Location" AS "Centre", AVG("Shuttle Run sec") AS avg_time FROM "sportathon_baseline" GROUP BY "Location"), endline AS (SELECT "Location" AS "Centre", AVG("Shuttle Run sec") AS avg_time FROM "sportathon_endline" GROUP BY "Location") SELECT b."Centre", e.avg_time - b.avg_time AS "Average Change in Shuttle Sprint Time" FROM baseline AS b JOIN endline AS e ON b."Centre" = e."Centre" ORDER BY b."Centre" NULLS FIRST

for each centre how much did the shuttle sprint time change on average between the two tests
attempts.response:
WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT "Location" AS "Centre", AVG("Shuttle Run sec") AS avg_time
  FROM "sportathon_baseline"
  GROUP BY "Location"
),
endline AS (
  SELECT "Location" AS "Centre", AVG("Shuttle Run sec") AS avg_time
  FROM "sportathon_endline"
  GROUP BY "Location"
)
SELECT 
  b."Centre",
  e.avg_time - b.avg_time AS "Average Change in Shuttle Sprint Time"
FROM baseline b
JOIN endline e ON b."Centre" = e."Centre"
ORDER BY b."Centre";
